name: Portfolio
description: A responsive and visually appealing portfolio built with modern web technologies. Showcases professional skills, projects, experience, and contact details — designed to highlight technical strengths and personal achievements.

paragraphs: This project is the source code for my personal developer portfolio, beautifully crafted using TypeScript and modern web technologies. Here, you’ll find a showcase of my best projects, technical skills, and career highlights—all wrapped up in a sleek, interactive design.
Whether you’re here for inspiration, collaboration, or just browsing, feel free to explore the code, fork the repo, or reach out for networking and opportunities.
🌟 Turning ideas into reality, one commit at a time.
features: Dynamic Project Showcases: Explore detailed presentations of my top work.
Responsive Design: Seamless experience across all devices.
Modern Tech Stack: Built with TypeScript for reliability and scalability.
Live Preview: Visit my portfolio site to see it in action!
